caption: The drawing contains two representations of a wooden bowl object on a plain, beige background. At the top of the page is a line drawing in reddish-brown ink showing the side profile of a bowl with upward-curving ends and a central, circular, low pedestal or foot. Below this, occupying the center of the composition, is a detailed, colored rendering of the bowl as seen from above. This top-down view depicts the bowl with a rich, varied brown and orange woodgrain texture, featuring natural swirls, knots, and color variations in the wood. A distinct circular area is present in the center of the bowl, likely the base, with a darker circular dot at its middle. The artist's signature, "Beverly Chichester," is written in reddish-brown ink on the lower right portion of the artwork. There are no additional objects or background elements in the drawing aside from these two representations of the bowl.
title: Walnut Burl Bowl
